summary: Frontend re-verification was blocked by the deployed preview serving 403 for all Next.js client chunks; the page title loads but the UI remains blank.

ui_bugs.issue: Initial HTML loads, but client JavaScript chunks under /_next/static/chunks return HTTP 403, so the app never hydrates and the body is empty.

action_items: Fix preview/deployment routing or permissions for /_next/static/chunks so client assets return 200; rerun all requested flows afterward.
critical_code_review_comments: The current runtime cannot execute the React app because the deployed client chunks are forbidden; feature-level verification is not possible until asset serving is fixed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Source review confirms theme persistence and multiplayer memorize phase logic, plus Settings accessibility test IDs. Live verification stopped at blank preview: title loads, body text is empty, and console reports 403 for multiple /_next/static/chunks assets and a 502 HMR websocket.
rca of the issue: Preview HTML references Next.js chunks that the preview proxy rejects with HTTP 403. Because hydration scripts fail, no buttons or screens are rendered. Supervisor logs also show stale /app/frontend and /app/backend working-directory paths in this container, indicating an environment/deployment routing mismatch rather than a tested feature interaction failure.
